stages.title: Code
stages.description: Implement the task using a test-driven approach.

stages.title: Verify
stages.description: Run the project's test and lint commands and report the outcome.

stages.title: Review
stages.description: Review the implementation for security, correctness, and alignment with task requirements.

stages.title: Document
stages.description: Review changes and update documentation if key decisions, behaviour changes, or constraints were introduced.

stages.title: Housekeeping
stages.description: Remove the worktrees of closed beads. Run `node <ralph-scripts>/prune-worktrees.mjs` from the main checkout and retry once if it exits non-zero. The exit status is 1 whenever any worktree survives — an open bead counts as survival — so fail this chore only when a closed-bead worktree is still refused after the retry, and leave it open. Never close it over a worktree the script did not remove.
